metadata.title: Symmetrical Glamour Portrait with Futuristic Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A mirrored profile composition featuring high-gloss glamour lighting against a textured magenta background with wide, futuristic display type.
excludeWhen: single subject non-mirrored layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition of two identical female profiles facing each other, characterized by warm, high-contrast glamour lighting and a textured, sparkling magenta background. The lower third features wide, futuristic typography with a metallic, beveled effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical mirroring of the central subject
High-contrast warm skin tones against cool magenta background
Horizontal typographic anchor balancing the verticality of the profiles
Textured glitter background contrasting with smooth, glossy skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale profiles mirrored on the left and right edges, facing inward toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The negative space between the two noses at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the mirrored faces, move down to the bold typography at the bottom, and circulate through the textured background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A central vertical channel of magenta glitter texture between the two faces.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the skin and text.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with horizontal slicing
Beveled edges with internal metallic gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature horizontal gaps or 'speed lines' cutting through the strokes
The 'A' is a triangular shape with a low crossbar

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family futuristic display type with varying scales for artist name and title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric wide skeleton

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a mirrored profile portrait of a woman with high-gloss skin and wind-swept hair against a magenta glitter background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-wide, futuristic, beveled metallic text in the lower third, featuring horizontal slices through the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the background a textured magenta glitter?
Is the typography ultra-wide and beveled?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized futuristic type

postGenerationChecks: Confirm hair flow is mirrored correctly
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirrored Profile + Magenta Glitter + Futuristic Wide Type = Glamour Pop Aesthetic
